notes.title: Update to v1.2
notes.notes:
Features
Hint System
We added a Hint System so players don't get stuck for too long on a puzzle. It's optional, so if players want to solve things on their own without any help they still can do just that :) 
After some amount of time in an area a little questionmark pops up prompting you to press a button. By doing so you get a hint on how to solve the puzzle.

Continue Button
Added a continue button to the menu that loads the latest save game (sorry it wasn't part of the game in the first place D:).

Level Reworks
Reworked Level 10 to 13 a bit to ensure better playability, challenge and fun 😊

Bug Fixes
Audio Trouble & Game Crash
Some people experienced issues with the sound when playing Duru for over two hours at a time. We couldn’t replicate that issue on our machines. We changed how FMOD Events are loaded in in an attempt to fix a memory issue that might cause these problems. We hope it works better for those who had this problem!

Distinguishing Input source in the main menu
Distinguishing between controller & keyboard in the main menu now works properly when first loading up the game.

AI issues
Fixed a Bug with moving platforms causing errors in the grid that Bels Movement is based on. That little monster should annoy you now just in the intended ways.

notes.title: Duru Patch Notes - 2023/05/22
notes.notes:
Hey there!

First Patch for Duru, let's go!

Bug Fixes

 Bel didn't recognize Roots & Stones they've been painted many times. Now it does!
 When standing on a boulder that's riding a moving platform Tuli is now actually being moved with it.
 Solved an issue with Tuli falling through certain moving platforms when moving diagonally
 Preventing Tuli from getting stuck in one of the mole rat houses forever and ever.
 Added fail safes for collider glitches that keep happening on corners.


Features / Feature Changes

 Changing controller input for throwing.
 Added quality of lfe features for throwing with multiple aiming attempts.
 Smoothed out aiming movement.
 Changed some level structures.
 Changed shift key graphic in tutorial plates to make it clearer which key it is since shift looks different on every keyboard.



Thanks to everyone who contacted us with bugs. We continue working on them and improving Duru!

notes.title: Release Delay
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
today should’ve been the day but as you can guess from the headline we are facing a delay.
It feels like 86 years since we started working on Duru, so another unplanned delay of one or two days shouldn't hurt that much but it does. 

This is due to an issue with the Mac build right before the finish line. This in turn delays the verification process of the build. To everyone who supported our crowdfunding campaign: you can still access and play the game like during the Beta Phase.
We are very sorry about this and hope that this will push back the release only one or two day.

Next News will be about the new date once we know more!

notes.title: Demo Update, New Gameplay Trailer & Gamescom
notes.notes:
Demo Update

Hello friends of the mole rat (not the naked kind)!

We updated the demo of Duru! Explore the caves around the mole rat colony in their new beauty. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38493673/880c39f02fb312401d975c0e4ba5bf8b2513f6fe.jpg

Some bugs and issues were fixed as well. Here is a short list. We don’t want to keep you too long, best see for yourself what’s new!


 new graphic assets: plants, backgrounds, decorations
 improved visualization for throwing objects
 better visibility for interactable objects like levers
 adjustments of puzzles in the level
 bug fixes regarding the AI companion, movement and camera movement

We’d love to hear your feedback so stop by in the forums! <3 


New Gameplay Trailer

With the new demo (and new mechanics that are in the final release version) we also decided to make a new gameplay trailer. What do you think about it? Feel free to leave your feedback and enjoy the new look of our intro to Duru. 

(Pssst… watch until the end so you can see a secret end! :O)
